description: renovated 2 bed, 2 bath luxury condo in one of Boston's most desirable waterfront neighborhoods. This spacious home offers high-end finishes throughout, including a private deck off the primary bedroom and an additional balcony off the kitchen. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide abundant natural light and highlight oak hardwood floors. The modern kitchen features solid wood cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances. Additional amenities include central HVAC, high-efficiency tankless hot water heaters, in-unit washer/dryer, and dedicated basement storage. Enjoy waterfront walks with stunning BostonHarbor views, summer water taxi access to the Seaport and Charlestown, and proximity to The ReelHouse.
